q: Then the Heavenly Sovereign grieved and lamented, and at night, while on his divine couch, there appeared [to him] in an august dream the Great Deity the Great-Master-of-Things, and said: "This is my august doing. So if thou wilt cause me to be worshipped by Oho-tata-ne-ko, the divine spirit shall not arise, and the land will be tranquillized."

s: preparations for the conquest of Korea requires offerings to deities of the river and of the sea
q: and likewise of the Deities of the mountains and also of all the Deities of the river and of the sea

s: preparations for the conquest of Korea uses podocarpus macrophylla tree (ashes placed into gourds)
q: put into gourds the ashes of the podocarpus macrophylla tree

s: preparations for the conquest of Korea uses gourds (to contain ashes)
q: put into gourds the ashes of the podocarpus macrophylla tree

s: preparations for the conquest of Korea uses chopsticks (made in quantity)
q: and likewise make a quantity of chopsticks and also of leaf platters

s: preparations for the conquest of Korea uses leaf platters (made in quantity)
q: and likewise make a quantity of chopsticks and also of leaf platters

s: august vessels are carried by fishes of the sea-plain (great and small)
q: the fishes of the sea-plain, both great and small, all bore the august vessels across their backs

s: Land of Shiragi is a feeder of the august horses (constituted as such)
q: So therefore the Land of Shiragi was constituted the feeder of the august horses

s: Land of Kudara is a crossing store (constituted as such)
q: and the Land of Kudara was constituted the crossing store.

s: Emperor Chiū-Ai dwells at palace of Kashihi
q: and likewise at the palace of Kashihi in Tsukushi

s: Land of Shiragi is ruled by chieftain of Shiragi
q: the chieftain of the country, alarmed and trembling. petitioned [the Empress]

s: Rough August Spirits of the Great Deities of the Inlet of Sumi are guardian deities of Land of Shiragi
q: having made the Rough August Spirits of the Great Deities of the Inlet of Sumi the guardian Deities of the land

s: Umi is the birthplace of Heir Apparent (in the Land of Tsukushi)
q: the name by which the place was called where the august child was born was Umi.

s: palace of Kashihi is located in Tsukushi
q: and likewise at the palace of Kashihi in Tsukushi

s: mourning-vessel contains Heir Apparent (during the feigned report of his death)
q: prepared a mourning-vessel, set the august child in that mourning-vessel

s: Noble Isahi is ancestor of Kishi Clan of Naniha (generalissimo of King Oshikuma)
q: King Oshikuma made the Noble Isahi, ancestor of the Kishi Clan of Naniha, his generalissimo

s: Naniha-ne-ko-take-furu-kuma is ancestor of Grandees of Wani (generalissimo on the august side of the Heir Apparent)
q: His Augustness Naniha-ne-ko-take-furu-kuma, ancestor of the Grandees of Wani, was made generalissimo.

s: Noble Isahi is a generalissimo (of King Oshikuma)
q: King Oshikuma made the Noble Isahi, ancestor of the Kishi Clan of Naniha, his generalissimo

s: Naniha-ne-ko-take-furu-kuma is a generalissimo (on the august side of the Heir Apparent)
q: His Augustness Naniha-ne-ko-take-furu-kuma, ancestor of the Grandees of Wani, was made generalissimo.

s: Heir Apparent dwells at Tsunuga (in a temporary palace)
q: he built a temporary palace at Tsunuga at the mouth of the Road of Koshi [for the Heir Apparent] to dwell in.

s: Tsunuga is located at Road of Koshi (at its mouth)
q: he built a temporary palace at Tsunuga at the mouth of the Road of Koshi

s: Emperor Chiū-Ai rules Empire
q: and ruled the Empire.

s: Heir Apparent exchanges name with Great Deity Izasa-wake
q: I wish to exchange my name for the august name of the august child.

s: Great Deity Izasa-wake has other name Food-Wondrous-Great-Deity (after the name exchange)
q: So again his august name was honoured by his being called the Great Deity of August Food." So he is now styled the Food-Wondrous-Great-Deity

s: broken-nosed dolphin-fishes are food for Heir Apparent (presented as an offering)
q: Thou bestowest on me fish of thine august food.

s: Chiura is an earlier name of Tsunuga (the strand was called Chiura; now Tsunuga)
q: So the strand was called by the name of Chiura. it is now styled Tsunuga.

s: great august liquor is called Drinking Songs
q: These are Drinking Songs.
